request.reason: Correct the executor-created CLI declaration error: the previous scope contained prose split on commas instead of path patterns. Express exactly the five paths already authorized in the WI-1094 handoff and current bounded Stage 1 repair request. This changes no acceptance criterion, verification command, authority, or out-of-scope boundary and does not assert human confirmation or successful verification.

acceptanceCriteria: The successor is based on the synchronized default revision b8ec2690976ab4c554aa9f5b2aa7fcca715156ca and preserves the exact original candidate commits d77a0183b6924ca8e18b43c629349b8fd72e4d38 and dc54015dcad039526d1b9eefc8b2e4bf29673926 as source provenance.

Add a negative regression showing a receipt whose item identity differs from the map key is rejected, including that one receipt cannot cover multiple distinct expected item identities; demonstrate red against the imported buggy implementation and green after the identity check is added.

Bind verification acceptance to the actual VerificationEvidenceRecord fields using the domain digest calculation: require successful exit status and a matching recomputed evidence digest to the bound snapshot; regressions must reject changed command, exit code, or logs and demonstrate red/green behavior. Do not describe a boolean flag or test verifier as real execution proof.
Keep NoAuthorityVerifierConfigured permanently Unverifiable and retain test-double verifier only in tests; no existing production admission path calls the new domain crate.

Run cargo test -p cockpit-review-receipt; cargo test -p cockpit-git --test repository -- --test-threads=1; cargo clippy -p cockpit-review-receipt -p cockpit-git --no-deps --lib --tests --all-features -- -D warnings; and cargo check -p cockpit-review-receipt -p cockpit-git --all-targets --all-features. Report actual exit codes. Historical serial and parallel failures remain in the handoff unchanged.
No files in cockpit-repository, old WI records, or global Runtime are changed; do not claim publication or production readiness.
previousContract.goal: In the standalone cockpit-review-receipt crate, ensure gate_admits rejects a receipt stored under a different item identity and cannot reuse one receipt to cover multiple items; ensure evaluate_item accepts verification only when the recorded evidence is successful and its recomputed digest matches BoundSnapshot.verification_evidence_digest. Prove both defects with failing-before/fixed-after regressions using the real domain decision logic.
